I am Mr.
D.A. Jackson, an old Patrician and a teacher of Science and Biology. I was appointed as Deputy Principal –
Curriculum by the Rector of the College, Rev. Fr. A.P. Thirumahan on 19th
February 2024.

I am Mr. M.
Berty Bannister, an old student of the College and have been teaching Health
& Physical Education since 1990. I
was appointed as Deputy Principal – Discipline by the Rector of the College on
